name: Toyono (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toyono town emblem in green: an outlined ring of segments enclosing a stylised letter G.
history: Municipal flag of Toyono, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 April 1977.

features.role: Toyono town emblem — an outlined ring of segments enclosing a stylised letter G
